how.title: How it works
how.p1: Balance is everything settled in minus everything settled out, across all months. Pending, planned and In savings entries never touch it until they are settled.
how.p2: Debits move along a pipeline: potential → pending → wallet. Marking one as received stamps today's date so it lands in the right month.
how.p3: Fixed monthly bills come back on their own every month. Each one stays Due until you choose Savings or Paid. A bill you leave alone stays Due and shows as late, unless you asked for it to be marked as paid by itself. Pausing a bill removes what has not started yet; paid history always stays.
how.p4: Savings means the money is there but the bill is not paid yet. It stays in your balance and the bill is marked paid automatically one month after its date, then next month’s bill comes back as Due. Free to spend already leaves out your bills, so it does not move when you press Savings or Paid.
